This implies that Npc237962 may act as a modulator or regulator of the downstream pathway involving Anguidine deriv scirpentriol, which ultimately targets SK-VLB. The integration of these targets suggests a possible role for Npc237962 in the regulation of SK-VLB through the action of Anguidine deriv scirpentriol. The evidence supports a mechanistic link where Npc237962 could influence SK-VLB via a target enzyme, potentially through a complex regulatory network.
